descriptionStyle: Say what the thing IS and who would want it.
Never start with 'This is' or 'A website that'.
Prefer concrete nouns over vague claims.
notes: Groups are tags, not a hierarchy: a bookmark may belong to several at once.
Ungrouped is groups: [] — there is deliberately no 'Unsorted' group here.
A slash in a name (AI/ML) is an opaque character, not a path separator.
